mapper.sql: id, title, notice_type as noticeType, notice_type as type, target_role as targetRole, target_role as target, content, publish_status as publishStatus, publish_status as status, publish_time as publishTime, created_by as createdBy, case when publish_status = '已发布' then 'success' when publish_status = '定时发布' then 'primary' when publish_status = '草稿' then 'info' else 'warning' end as tagType, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt
mapper.select:
select
from notice order by coalesce(publish_time, created_at) desc, id desc
mapper.insert: insert into notice ( title, notice_type, target_role, content, publish_status, publish_time, created_by ) values ( #{title}, coalesce(nullif(#{noticeType}, ''), nullif(#{type}, ''), '系统提醒'), coalesce(nullif(#{targetRole}, ''), nullif(#{target}, ''), 'labAdmin'), #{content}, coalesce(nullif(#{publishStatus}, ''), nullif(#{status}, ''), '草稿'), coalesce(#{publishTime}, now()), #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: update notice set title = #{notice.title}, notice_type = coalesce(nullif(#{notice.noticeType}, ''), nullif(#{notice.type}, ''), notice_type), target_role = coalesce(nullif(#{notice.targetRole}, ''), nullif(#{notice.target}, ''), target_role), content = #{notice.content}, publish_status = coalesce(nullif(#{notice.publishStatus}, ''), nullif(#{notice.status}, ''), publish_status), publish_time = coalesce(#{notice.publishTime}, publish_time), updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
